review.author: Hana T.
review.comment: Walking through the Arashiyama bamboo grove at sunrise was the highlight of my whole trip to Japan.

review.author: Marco D.
review.comment: Fushimi Inari is unmissable, go early to avoid the crowds and get the gates to yourself.

review.author: Ellie R.
review.comment: The bungee jump off Kawarau Bridge was terrifying and amazing at the same time. Do it.

review.author: Josh P.
review.comment: Every direction you look is a postcard. The gondola ride at sunset is worth every dollar.

review.author: Amara K.
review.comment: Stone Town's spice tours were fascinating and the beaches in the north are unbelievably calm and clear.

review.author: Sven L.
review.comment: Saw the northern lights on our second night and spent the next day soaking in the Blue Lagoon. Perfect trip.

review.author: Nina B.
review.comment: Prices are steep but the golden circle tour and glacier hike made it worth the splurge.

review.author: Youssef A.
review.comment: Jemaa el-Fnaa square at night is pure sensory overload in the best way. Bring your bargaining skills.

review.author: Grace W.
review.comment: Lake Louise at sunrise looks fake, like a painting. Best hiking trip I have ever taken.

review.author: Tom H.
review.comment: Spotted a grizzly bear from a safe distance on the Johnston Canyon trail, unforgettable.

review.author: Priya S.
review.comment: Ubud's rice terraces and the sunrise hike up Mount Batur were both incredible experiences.

review.author: Liam F.
review.comment: Canggu has such a good mix of surf, cafes, and coworking spots if you want to stay longer term.

review.author: Sofia M.
review.comment: Rode tram 28 through the Alfama district and got lost in the best possible way.

review.author: Daniel K.
review.comment: Hiking Table Mountain then driving to Boulders Beach to see the penguins in one day was unforgettable.

review.author: Mei C.
review.comment: Visited during the Yi Peng lantern festival and it genuinely brought me to tears, so beautiful.
